nodes.name: 02 Intro / text — This September, we come together at Aura jus
nodes.text:
This September, we come together at Aura just as the estate moves towards harvest.
Friends begin arriving from the 20th.
Boojee and BESST join us on the 23rd.
And for a few days, we walk, taste, make, ask questions, get our hands dirty, eat together and spend time in good company.
Then harvest begins.

nodes.name: 05 The days / photo — Friends of Aura (20 Sep)
05 The days / text — Friends of Aura
05 The days / text — Before everyone comes together, Aura begins
nodes.text:
Before everyone comes together, Aura begins to fill slowly. 
Friends arrive from Singapore and different parts of India. There is no need to rush into a programme. These days are for finding the place.

nodes.name: 05 The days / list — Arrive.
nodes.text:
Arrive.
Coffee.
Find your room.
Walk.
Meet whoever is around.
Eat together.
Sit by the fire.
Let Aura introduce itself.

nodes.name: 05 The days / text — Good to be here.
05 The days / photo — Find your rhythm (21 Sep)
05 The days / list — Wake early if you want to.
nodes.text:
Wake early if you want to.
Follow the cows.
Walk with someone from the estate.
Find coffee somewhere.
Spend time in the field.
Eat.
Talk.
Do nothing for a while.
There is no need to see everything.

nodes.name: 05 The days / text — Find your rhythm
05 The days / text — I’m beginning to understand this place.
nodes.text: I’m beginning to understand this place.

nodes.name: 05 The days / list — Spend more time with the people
nodes.text:
Spend more time with the people of Aura.
Help make something.
Walk deeper into the estate.
Join what is already happening.
By the time everyone else arrives, Aura should feel a little less like somewhere you are visiting.

nodes.name: 05 The days / text — I’m starting to become part of the place.
nodes.text: I’m starting to become part of the place.

nodes.name: 05 The days / photo — Company comes together (22 Sep)
05 The days / text — Boojee and BESST arrive.
nodes.text:
Boojee and BESST arrive. 
The full company comes together. 
No big programme.
Arrive.
Settle.
Coffee.
Walk.
Meet.
Then dinner.

nodes.name: 05 The days / text — The company comes together
05 The days / photo — full bleed (23 Sep)
05 The days / text — White. Indigo. Or both.
05 The days / list — Nothing more complicated than th
nodes.text:
Nothing more complicated than that. A simple visual thread for the first evening when everyone is together.
Good food. A long table. Conversation. Maybe music. Maybe fire. No speeches required.
Tonight, just good company.

nodes.name: 05 The days / photo — Arrive & Exhale (24 Sep)
05 The days / list — Now we slow the pace. Not to do
nodes.text:
Now we slow the pace. Not to do less. To notice more.
Welcome into Aura.
Know each other differently.
The Aura Pause.
Shavasana.
Stars.

nodes.name: 05 The days / text — I am somewhere special.
05 The days / photo — See & Feel (25 Sep)
05 The days / text — There is so much happening here.
nodes.text: There is so much happening here.

nodes.name: 05 The days / list — The first day belongs to noticin
nodes.text:
The first day belongs to noticing. Not only coffee. What grows above it. What lives beneath it. What moves through it. And the people who care for it.
Sensory estate walk.
Biodiversity discoveries.
Fungi.
Shade.
Soil.
People of Aura.
Coffee cupping.

nodes.name: 05 The days / list — Cow to soil. Soil to tree. Tree
nodes.text:
Cow to soil. Soil to tree. Tree to harvest. Observation to memory. Memory to better decisions.
BD500.
CPP.
Soil biology.
Hungry Soil experiment.
Plant health.
Food and fermentation.
Aura Intelligence.
Field memories.

nodes.name: 05 The days / text — Now I understand how it connects.
nodes.text: Now I understand how it connects.

nodes.name: 05 The days / photo — Make It Yours (27 Sep)
05 The days / list — Plant something. Make something.
nodes.text:
Plant something. Make something.  Leave something behind.  Take something with you.
Plant Your Tree.
Natural Dye.
Final walk.
Food together.
Your Aura Memory.

05 The days / text — I was part of Aura.

nodes.name: 06 Two arcs / text — The days have structure. They also have room
nodes.text:
The days have structure. They also have room.
Weather may move things. The estate may move things. Something unexpected may become more interesting than something we planned.

nodes.text: This is a working estate. Walk. Explore.  Get your hands dirty. Taste. Create. Pause.  Ask. Notice. Discover.

07 Come prepared / body — Ask the obvious question.  It is
nodes.text: Ask the obvious question.  It is often the useful one.

nodes.name: 07 Come prepared / body — Touch. Taste. Make. Try. Discuss
nodes.text: Touch. Taste. Make. Try. Discuss. Share.

nodes.name: 07 Come prepared / body — Look before photographing.  Obse
nodes.text: Look before photographing.  Observe before asking for the answer.

07 Come prepared / heading — Respect the working farm
07 Come prepared / heading — Bring what you know
07 Come prepared / body — Weather and the estate may chang
nodes.text: Weather and the estate may change the rhythm, and we let the day move.

nodes.name: 07 Come prepared / body — The people, animals and land are
nodes.text: The people, animals and land are not here for our visit. We are entering something already alive.

nodes.name: 07 Come prepared / body — Coffee. Food. Technology. Plants
nodes.text: Coffee. Food. Technology. Plants. Design. Storytelling. People. Everyone coming knows something somebody else does not.

nodes.name: 08 Scatter close / heading — with Boojee and BESST.
08 Scatter close / list — Friends with friends.
nodes.text:
Friends with friends.
Coffee with shade.
Roots with fungi.
Cows with soil.
Food with season.
Knowledge with memory.
And all of us with the land.

nodes.name: 08 Scatter close / text — Nothing here grows alone.
09 Gratitude / text — Harvest begins with gratitude.
09 Gratitude / text — Prayer belongs to the beginning of harvest.
nodes.text:
Prayer belongs to the beginning of harvest.
It is not a performance. It is not an activity.
It is a moment to acknowledge what the land has given before we begin taking from it.
Guests may be invited to participate where appropriate. 
Mostly, we listen.

nodes.name: 10 Remember / text — What should Aura remember from today?
nodes.text: What should Aura remember from today?

nodes.name: 10 Remember / text — Every evening, one question.
nodes.text:
Every evening, one question. 
It may be answered with a sentence, a photograph, something learned, something funny, something small, something we should change, something we should never change. 
The gathering should leave more than photographs behind. It should leave memory.

nodes.name: A sentence, observation, or something that happened today...
nodes.text: A sentence, observation, or something that happened today...

nodes.name: Mornings with nothing on the calendar.
nodes.text: Mornings with nothing on the calendar.

nodes.text: Memories added here stay with this page for now — nothing is sent anywhere yet.

nodes.text: Some guests will leave another kind of memory.

nodes.name: 11 Tree registry / text — A tree. Coffee, cacao, shade or another plan
nodes.text:
A tree. Coffee, cacao, shade or another plant chosen according to what belongs in the land. 
The relationship continues after the visit ends.

nodes.name: 12 The harvest / text — The gathering finishes on 27 September. Harv
nodes.text: The gathering finishes on 27 September. Harvest does not.

nodes.name: 12 The harvest / text — From here Aura moves through:
12 The harvest / text — The page should continue with the harvest un
nodes.text: The page should continue with the harvest until February. What happened to the coffee. What became a lot. What tasted extraordinary. What failed. What changed. What we learned. What still needs another season.

nodes.text: The harvest timeline opens once the gathering ends on 27 September.
